profile.headline: Implementing Chaos Engineering in Back-end using Polly Framework, creating policies of execution in .NET
profile.summary:
Senior .NET Full Stack Developer

###### 18+ years of strong experience as .NET Full Stack Developer.   ######

###### 12+ years of .NET Full Stack experience in Web Applications.                 ###### 

######  10+ years of UI/UX, AngularJs, Angular2+, RXJS, TypeScript, JavaScript   ####

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
◦ Implement Chaos Engineering in Back-end using Polly Framework
        ◦ Add new UI features using React, JavaScript, JSON, CSS. 
        ◦ Code Analysis to determine the best practice. 
        ◦ Developed the application using .NET Core 3 and Net Framework 4.x, 5.X, Wep API, C#, LIN-Q. 
        ◦ Designed components using reducers and actions with React.js and Redux.
        ◦ Add new features on their Windows Services
        ◦ Automation of process using Shell scripts 
        ◦ Responsible for writing the Actions in the Controllers which implement the Business Rules, and which act as a mediator between API and Database (Model).
        ◦ Developed Restful Web API with HTTP GET, HTTP POST, HTTP PUT, and HTTP DELETE implementing Policies of Execution

Environment: .NET Framework 4.x, 5.x, C#, Ado.NET, SQL Server, AWS, Polly React.js, NET core 3.1, Microservices, Rest Full, JSON, XML,  Shell
positions.insights: Skills: Chaos Engineering · React.js · Operating Systems · Microsoft SQL Server · C# · polly · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
As Comcast software Developer, I collaborated with projects in C# Using .Net Frameworks and Net Core to be enhancing and create new features.

Responsibilities.
•	Designed the web UI using ASP.NET, HTML, DHTML, jQuery, Angular js, JavaScript, JSON, CSS, XSL, Web Forms and AJAX controls. 
•	Code Analysis to determine the best practice the code. 
•	Developed the application using .NET Core 2.0.3, MVC Web API, C#, Ajax, Html5, CSS3, JSON and LINQ.
•	Used XML files to store data and to bind data with the Controls in the Swagger to check data reliability.
•	Developed and support above applications in C#, ADO.NET, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python
•	Strictly implemented mobile-first approach and responsive web design. Designed components using JSX and reducers and actions using React.js and Redux using the latest version of JavaScript (ECMA 6).
•	Implemented a AWs serverless and S3 service’ Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline with Visual Studio team services and Update YML scripts
•	Developed UI layer using React and Redux framework. Implemented Authentication and authorization for better security of an application. Applied Multithreading techniques for creating high-performance applications. 
•	Responsible for writing the Actions in the Controllers which implement the Business Rules, and which act as a mediator between API and Database (Model).
•	Developed RESTful Web API with HTTP GET, HTTP POST, HTTP PUT, and HTTP DELETE
•	Tested all application controllers extensively with Angular.js built-in testing facilities.
•	Developed and support above applications in C#, ADO.NET, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Visual Studio 2019/2017.
•	Developed Web Services and Rest WEB API's which can be used by the number of clients in getting useful data. Used Entity Framework to perform CRUD operations on the SQL Server 2012 through 2016 database

Environment: .NET 3.0, C#, Ado.NET, PostgreSQL, SonarQube, NET core 3.1, Microservices, Rest Full, JSON, XML

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Code Analysis to determine the best practice a fix duplicate and redundant issues in the code.
• Solve Security issues as (XSS) Cross Site Scripting
• Cross-site request forgery (CSRF)
• Session hijacking Fix
• Reduce SQL scripts to clean duplicate and redundant functions.
• Implement new Rules in Snyk, SonarQube and Checkmarx to accept pipe functions and custom
directives in Angular.
• Monitoring AWS Cloud Watch when pipe lines are running and fix issues in the report
• Developed and support above applications in C#, ADO.NET, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Visual Studio
2019/2017.
• Developed the application using .NET Core 2.0.3, MVC Web API, C#, Ajax, Html5, CSS3, JSON and
LINQ.
• Responsible for developing the Data Access Layer (Model) using ADO.Net, LINQ to Entities, and C#.•

Coordinating and tracking all projects for seamless releases using Project Management System JIRA.
Used XML files to store data and to bind data with the Controls in the Swagger to check data
reliability.
Developed database objects such as tables, views, stored procedures, triggers, and user defined
functions for database operations.
Implemented a Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline with Visual Studio
team services.
Used docker container for the release definition to host.Build and maintain code repositories and
code migrations using CI/CD strategies (GIT, SVN, CSV, Jenkins)
Responsible for writing the Actions in the Controllers which implement the Business Rules, and which
act as a mediator between API and Database (Model).
Developed RESTful Web API with HTTP GET, HTTP POST, HTTP PUT, and HTTP DELETE method using
both convention-based routing and custom routing for administrator to achieve book schedule
function.

Environment: .NET 4.0, C#, Ado.NET, PostgreSQL Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx NET core 3.1/2.0, Angular
10/9/8/6, Kernel, Microservices, Rest Full, HTML5, SCSS, CSS3, RXJS, JSON, XML, SQL, TypeScript,
JavaScript, Python, GI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

DFG is a new platform that manages personal investments and allows users to have a friendly interactive
experience while managing their own savings.

Analysis with Project Mangers, Database Administrators, Architects and QA to complete business
initiatives.
Design strategies and models to improve the current architecture.
Design and maintained database in Creating tables in SQL Server and documents in MongoDB, views,
SQL Joins, user defined functions, Triggers and stored procedures for different type of operations like
updating and getting data.
Implement the best design patterns like Domain Driven Design, create classes for Core, Infrastructure,
Database and Test, using SOLID principles to code in C#, TypeScript and SQL server
Develop Microservices using C# NET Core as backend and build all the endpoints to get data through
WCF.
Develop classes in TypeScript to receive data from external endpoints.
Create promises and Observables in TypeSript and JavaScript to run functions asynchronously.•
•
•
•
•
•
•
•
•
Develop new components in UI layer using Angular, HTML5, CSS3 and Bootstrap to build rich,
responsive, and flexible user interactive web pages.
Updates libraries as RXJS to migrate to new versions of Angular.
Create unit tests for every added functionality using XUnit in C#.
Logging all messaging or any exceptions to Application Insights.
Participating on Scrum meetings and agile methodology to manage project.
Used GIT with DevOps to manage code versioning and release process.
Participated in daily scrums & weekly meetings backlog grooming to meet expectations and deadlines.

Environment: C#, .Net Core 3.1/2.0, Net Framework, Ado.Net, WCF, Angular 10/9/8/6, Kernel,
Microservices, Rest Full, HTML5, CSS3, RXJS, JSON, XML, SQL Server, MongoDB, TypeScript, JavaScript,
bitbucket, GIT.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
NET Full Stack Developer 

Dell DSA stands for Dell Sales Application, an enterprise-level application focused on quoting customers and creating orders. The main line of business focuses on quoting customers and creating orders, customer management and product discovery. 

Responsibilities:  

Analysis with owners, team leader and Architects to complete business initiatives. 

Created & implemented stored procedures, functions, indexes and Triggers using T-SQL. 

Create abstract classes, interfaces, classes to construct business logic using C#.  

Build new endpoints on C# to create new microservices in .NET Core 3.1 to get data through WCF 

Enhancement DSA-Sales to work for other countries, Updating tables, triggers and store procedures in SQL Server 

Enhancement DSA-Sales to work for other countries, Updating and building new components in Angular 6 

Develop classes in typeScript to receive data from external end-ponints 

Cerate promises and Observables in TypeSript and javaScript to run functions asynchronously 

Migrate services and tools in AngularJS to Angular 6 using REDUX Pattern 

Create unit tests for every added functionality in C# using XUnit. 

Create unit tests for every added functionality in Angular using Jazmin. 

Logging all messaging or any exceptions to Application Insights. 

Participating on Scrum meetings and agile methodology to manage project. 

Used GIT with DevOps to manage code versioning and release process. 

Participated in daily scrums & weekly meetings backlog grooming to meet expectations and deadlines.   

Environment: .Net 4.0, Ado.Net, WCF, C#, Net Framework, .NET Core 3.1/2.0, MVC, Web API, Angular 4,6,7 RXJS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS3, Gitlab, GIT, SQL Server, AngularJS

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
IT Manager 

Manage IT Area: Coordinate the Web pages development and Web Applications development, according to the client's requirements and be on charge IT department. 

Responsibilities:  

Supported 	companies such as PETCO, C&A Foundation, PISA, IBERDROLA, AKRON, 	GRUPO GIGANTE, are clients that have high demand performance and high demand standards in their applications.	 

Build back-end Environment using Go Language 

Created Cloud REST APIs and campaigns integrated with 3rd party APIs/SDKs for Facebook, Twitter and Instagram. 

Coordinate new projects, construction of E-Commerce, content updates, build responsive pages, server administration, construction of web pages, quotation analysis 

Successfully implemented Data Migration from MS Access legacy to SQL Server 2014 and completed performance testing too.	 

Create environments to migrate all the applications to AWS 

Involved in the overall technical architecture of the web application. 

Worked closely with core technology teams and other platform teams to balance cross-platform consistency. 

Designed and developed abstract classes, interfaces, classes to construct business logic using C#.  

Created the UI layers and web pages and integrated them to maintain the performance of data flow and data Integrity using HTML5, Angular, PHP, CSS and JavaScript 

Implemented web services with SOA using WCF for passing data to multiple platforms.  

Worked with Web Services, State Management, Caching features, and configuring Optimizations for securing the web application.  

Created & implemented stored procedures, functions, indexes and Triggers using T-SQL and MySQL. 

Utilized Git for the purpose of version Control and source code maintenance Needs.  

Environment: C#, .NET, MVC, Web Services, GO, IIS, LINQ, CSS, JavaScript, Agile Development, AJAX, JSON, jQuery, LINQ, SQL 2014, .NET Framework, Visual Studio Code, SQL Server, MySQL, PHP, 3rd party APIs for Facebook, Twitter and Instagram
